coords.description: 21 landmarks x (x,y,z), wrist-origin, scale-normalized, handedness-mirrored to Right

angles.description: 5 fingers x 3 angles (base-flex, tip-flex, spread-vs-middle), degrees

tipDistances.description: thumb-index, index-middle, middle-ring, ring-pinky tip distances

velocity.description: (dX, dY) of wrist position per video frame within a detected burst, 0 outside one

provenanceNote: Two-level MLP dispatcher inspired by Hasanov et al. 2023's clustered-model concept; exact paper architecture unverified (paywalled). 'K' added to Cluster 6 (missing from spec); dynamic-letter set corrected to match the dataset's own 8 high-volume sequential-frame folders.
